title: Auto Beat | Trophyhub
features:
Death Order: Simon Says

Added Death Order: Simon Says support

Added Auto Play (follows every real order and ignores traps)

Added Trap Guard (keeps you from doing an order that isn't "Simon says", also when you play by hand)

Added Lobby Auto Queue (joins the queue and loads again in the match with Auto Play on)

Added support for No Man's Land, Musical Chairs, Split Second, The Chamber, Hot Potato and the Obby

Added Run From Threats

Added Hide From Killers

Added Auto Collect and Auto Eat

Added Lunch Order

Added Sprint On The Way and Reaction Time

Added Order Banner, Show Mines and Show Path

Added HUD (off by default)

Fixed small lag spikes during rounds

Added ESP, Fly, Noclip, Spectate and Freecam
